name: @anvil-di/anvil-codegen-wasm
description: WASM build of the anvil codegen pipeline. Same parser + graph + emitter as the native CLI, in-process for any host that runs WebAssembly (Node, browsers, Workers, Bun).

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/anvil-codegen-wasm --target nodejs --release --out-dir ../../packages/anvil-codegen-wasm/dist --out-name anvil_codegen_wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.json
